_meta.description: Milestone 6 full golden evaluation dataset. Stable identity is always {source, external_id}, resolved to document/chunk ids at scoring time (backend/src/app/evaluation/stable_ids.py) — never a raw chunk PK, since chunk replacement can change those. Evidence matching is document-level: a case is satisfied if ANY permitted chunk belonging to the named (source, external_id) document was retrieved/cited, not a specific chunk.
_meta.privileged_fields: note, forbidden_evidence, expected_conflict, expected_refusal_reason are evaluator-only — the runner must never pass them into GenerationContext or the Gemini request; see test_evaluation_privilege_isolation.py
